subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` and its normalized display-event union as supported plugin SDK API for third-party JSONL CLI backends?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally opt-in and respects the plugin/core boundary, but accepting a new public SDK contract determines future compatibility, documentation, and support obligations that source review cannot choose automatically.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow parser hook
options.body: Accept this opt-in plugin-owned parser seam, contingent on live third-party backend proof and normal API compatibility ownership.

options.title: Keep the existing built-in dialect boundary
options.body: Decline a new public SDK contract and leave non-built-in CLI integrations on their current text-oriented output path.

options.title: Request a different extensibility design
options.body: Pause this PR while maintainers define a narrower or more general plugin event contract before exposing new SDK types.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow parser hook
recommendation.body: Accept this opt-in plugin-owned parser seam, contingent on live third-party backend proof and normal API compatibility ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: Current review activity explicitly routed the public plugin-SDK decision to this person.
